name: ai-chat-app
description: ai-chat-app - Open Source, Self-Hosted ChatGPT app

variables.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Used to encrypt the NextAuth.js JWT and to hash email verification tokens, set to something long and random.

variables.name: NEXTAUTH_URL
variables.description: Set this to the IP:port used to access the container.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Email used to access the WebUI.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password used to access the WebUI.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: UMASK for newly created files. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
